mapper.insert: insert into post_comment ( post_id, post_author_uuid, user_uuid, content, status ) values ( #{postId}, #{postAuthorUuid}, #{userUuid}, #{content}, #{status} )
mapper.select: select pc.id, pc.post_id as postId, pc.user_uuid as userUuid, u.nickname as nickname, pc.content, pc.created_at as createdAt from post_comment pc left join user u on pc.user_uuid = u.uuid where pc.post_id = #{postId} and pc.status = 1 order by pc.created_at asc, pc.id asc
